_comment: Festal icons. Keys are month-day for fixed feasts and P+NNN paschal offsets for movable ones. `file` is served from parish/static/icons/. Every entry MUST carry a licence and a source: an icon whose origin nobody can name is one the parish cannot safely publish. Add entries with `manage.py add_feast_icon`.
